text:
Type: open bookcase with hutch top
Use: displaying and storing books, toys and boxes on open shelves; children's room, nursery, bedroom
Style: farmhouse, traditional, Scandinavian
Materials: white painted board, striped beadboard-look back panel, adjustable shelves
Colors: white, soft cream back panel
Shape: tall two-part unit with a shallow shelf hutch on a deeper open base, scalloped wavy crown, gently curved cut-out feet, several open shelves, medium visual weight
Feel: sweet, gentle, airy, homey
Goes with: pastel textiles, light wood, white walls, soft patterns; cottage or Scandinavian nurseries and children's rooms
